instruction.name: xvfcmp.slt.s
instruction.description: Compare corresponding single precision elements in `a` and `b`, save the comparison result (all ones if LT(Less than), all zeros otherwise) into `dst`. An exception is raised for QNaN.

notes: LASX vector floating-point compare. Measured on LA664 with normal float operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
